# prismasdwan_element_static_route (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Element Static Route.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "element_static_route".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_element_static_route" "example" {
  address_family     = "ipv4"
  description        = "Managed by Terraform"
  destination_prefix = "10.10.0.0/16"
  name               = "example_name"
  network_context_id = "<network_context_id>"
  nexthops = [{
    admin_distance       = 1
    nexthop_interface_id = "<nexthop_interface_id>"
    nexthop_ip           = "10.0.0.1"
    self                 = false
  }]
  scope = "local"
  tags  = ["terraform"]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `address_family` (String) Address family. Value: one of ipv4, ipv6.
- `description` (String) Description. Value: at most 256 characters.
- `destination_prefix` (String) Destination prefix.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `name` (String) Name. Value: at most 128 characters.
- `network_context_id` (String) Network context id.
- `nexthop_reachability_probe` (Boolean) Nexthop reachability probe. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `nexthops` (Attributes List) Nexthops. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nexthops))
- `scope` (String) Scope. Value: one of global, local.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. At most 10 items. Each item: at most 128 characters, matching `[^,\s]+`.
- `vrf_context_id` (String) Vrf context id. Value: at most 20 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,20}$`. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
